entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your performance interweaves with and enriches your ally’s skills.

Prerequisite(s): Bardic performance or raging song.

Benefit(s): You can attempt a DC 10 Perform check to aid the Perform check of an ally who also has this feat. If you succeed, your ally gains a +1 bonus for each 5 points of your check result; a check result of 10 grants a +2 bonus, a result of 15 grants a +3 bonus, and so on. If you fail, the discord applies a –5 penalty on your ally’s check.

Normal: Aid another checks grant a +2 bonus.
